says: In our lint tooling, the narrowed rule lets four spellings in a plain next/ test pass: a FileSystem service bound by yield* then aliased (const x = fs2) or bound with let, before x.makeTempDirectory() on NodeServices.layer; new Socket().connect(80, "example.com") from node:net; and a vi.stubGlobal("fetch") in one test, which silences a real remote fetch in another test of the same file even after vi.unstubAllGlobals().
proof: A RuleTester run of integrationTestName at 1311809c1 on next/apps/fabrika/src/probe.test.ts reported no error for each of the four. The stub flag is set for the whole file at starters.ts line 226, and service bindings are read only from a const declarator at line 193.
cost: No file in next/ does these today. A future one would run a real-thing law on pull requests.
